prompt: Which leap year happened exactly halfway between the birth of Shoghi Effendi and the founding of the college he attended?
answer: The college was founded in **1866**, and Shoghi Effendi was born in **1897**. The midpoint is **1881.5**, so no leap year falls exactly halfway. The nearest intervening leap year is **1880**.
